info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Realestate Listings Status-v1-spec
info.description: The Real Estate Listings Status API provides essential functionality to retrieve the current status of real estate listings. This API empowers users, such as real estate agents and investors, to efficiently monitor listing statuses, which can include active, pending, or sold. By utilizing this endpoint, consumers can make informed decisions based on the real-time condition of their listings. It facilitates seamless integration into real estate applications, enhancing user experience and operational efficiency.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the current status of all listings in the system. You can use this to check which listings are active, inactive, or in any other specified state.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the status of listings. It requires a properly formatted JSON body that adheres to the defined schema.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the current status of listings.
